title: Cartwise+ Plan Goodwill on the Grocery Order Service-Fee Share
content:
# Cartwise+ plan goodwill on the grocery order service-fee share

Cartwise Grocery Orders sets a goodwill raise on the fee share of a service-fee share refund from the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order and the period fees in its ledger.

**Clause.** When the Cartwise+ plan recorded on the order is annual and the customer's membership ledger shows at least 1 period fee charged within the last 12 whole calendar months, the fee share is raised by 20 percent; when the plan is monthly and the ledger shows at least 6 period fees within the last 6 whole calendar months, it is raised by 10 percent; otherwise there is no raise. The raise multiplies the unrounded fee share, and the raised share is rounded to the cent once.

**Counting months.** Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date, so a period fee counts as charged within the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N such months have passed from its charge date to today, and a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old.

## Schedule

| Plan billing cycle on the recorded membership | Period fees in the membership ledger | Raise on the fee share |
|---|---|---|
| Annual | At least 1 within the last 12 whole calendar months | 20 percent |
| Monthly | At least 6 within the last 6 whole calendar months | 10 percent |
| Any other position, or no membership recorded | — | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and figures)

- *Annual plan, fee 11 months old.* A period fee charged on 15 March 2025, read on 14 March 2026: eleven anniversaries (15 April through 15 February) fall on or before the reading date, so fewer than 12 whole months have passed and the fee counts. The raise is 20 percent.
- *Annual plan, fee 12 months old.* The same fee read on 15 March 2026: twelve anniversaries have passed, the fee no longer counts, and with no other period fee in the window there is no raise.
- *Monthly plan, five fees.* Five period fees within the last 6 whole calendar months: no raise. A sixth fee in the window gives 10 percent.
- *Raised figure.* A fee share of 1.2375 on an order meeting the annual row becomes 1.485 before its single rounding to the cent.

The plan and its billing cycle are those of the membership recorded on the order; the period fees are the fee charge entries in that customer's Cartwise+ Membership ledger.
